blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: The widespread adoption of Large Language Models (LLMs) demands reliable detection of human-authored versus synthetic text. However, current Transformer-based detectors often experience severe performance degradation during domain shifts and operate as opaque classifiers. This paper investigates the robustness and interpretability of fine-tuned Transformer models (DistilBERT, RoBERTa) by evaluating them against a custom out-of-distribution (OOD) dataset of hyper-local news synthesized via open-source LLMs (Llama 3, Mistral, Gemma). To analyze model decision boundaries, we apply a tripartite Explainable AI (xAI) framework using SHAP. Our analysis reveals three key phenomena: First, detectors often rely on a "Call-to-Action" syndrome inherent to instruction-tuned LLMs rather than generic machine text. Second, we observe a "Specificity Bias," where LLMs successfully bypass detection by hallucinating specific named entities and mimicking conversational imperfection. Finally, we illustrate the "Wikipedia Paradox," wherein formal, objective human writing is frequently misclassified as AI due to its low statistical burstiness. These findings demonstrate that purely statistical detection paradigms face systematic limitations in highly structured human domains, emphasizing the critical need for semantically-aware, interpretable detection architectures.
blocks.zh: 广泛采用"大语言模型"(LLMS)要求可靠地检测出由人作词与合成文字. 然而,当前基于变形器的探测器在域位移时往往会发生严重的性能退化并作为不透明的分级器运行. 本文根据通过开源LLMs(Llama 3,Mistral,Gemma)合成的超本地新闻的自定义外分送(OOD)数据集来评价微调变压器模型(DistilBERT,RoBERTa)的稳健性和可解释性. 为了分析示范决定界限,我们采用了一个使用SHAP的三方解释性AI(xAI)框架. 我们的分析揭示出三个主要现象: 首先,探测器往往依赖于指令调制LLMS所固有的"呼叫到行动"综合征,而不是通用机器文本. 其次,我们观测到一个"特定比斯"(Speciality Bias),其中LLMs通过对特定被命名的实体产生幻觉并模仿对话不完美而成功绕过检测. 最后,我们举例说明了"维基百科"(Wikipedia Paradox),其中正式,客观的人类写作由于统计快感低而经常被误归类为AI. 这些调查结果表明,纯粹的统计检测范式在高度结构化的人类领域面临系统性的局限性,强调迫切需要有清醒的、可解释的检测架构。

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en: The rapid proliferation of Large Language Models (LLMs), such as Llama 3, Mistral, and GPT-4, has democratized the generation of coherent, contextually nuanced text. As these models become increasingly integrated into daily applications—ranging from automated journalism to social media content creation—the ability to distinguish between human-authored and AI-generated text has emerged as a critical challenge for maintaining digital trust and academic integrity.
blocks.zh: 大语言模型(LLMs)的迅速扩散,如Llama 3,Mistral,和GPT-4,使生成连贯的,上下文细微的文本民主化. 随着这些模式日益融入日常应用——从自动化新闻到社交媒体内容的创造——区分人文和AI生成文本的能力已成为维持数字信任和学术完整性的关键挑战。

blocks.en: As discussed by Bender et al. [ 1 ] , the risks of large-scale synthetic text generation include the displacement of authentic discourse. This has led to an arms race between generative capabilities and detection methods [ 2 ] , rooted in long-standing stylometric research [ 3 ] .
blocks.zh: 如Bender等人所讨论。 [1],大规模合成文本生成的风险包括正文话语被取代. 这导致基因能力与探测方法之间的军备竞赛[2],其根源在于长期的定型研究[3]。

blocks.en: While current detection systems, predominantly based on fine-tuned Transformer architectures like BERT and RoBERTa, achieve high accuracies on their respective training distributions, they frequently exhibit severe performance degradation when confronted with OOD data. This vulnerability is particularly pronounced in hyper-local and short-form contexts, where the statistical variance of the text is inherently constrained. Furthermore, these deep learning models operate as opaque ”black boxes”. Binary Human vs. AI scores provide no insight into the linguistic features or generative artifacts driving predictions, obscuring whether models detect genuine synthetic patterns or merely overfit superficial domain idiosyncrasies.
blocks.zh: 虽然目前的探测系统主要以BERT和RoBERTa等微调变压器结构为基础,在各自的训练分布上实现了高强度,但在面对OOD数据时却经常表现出严重的性能退化. 这种脆弱性在超局部和短形式的环境下尤其明显,其中文本的统计差异本身就受到限制。 此外,这些深入的学习模式是不透明的“黑盒”。 二进制人与AI的分数无法对语言特征或传入基因的文物来驱动预测,模糊模型是检测出真实的合成图案还是仅仅是过于相配的表面域特异性.

We systematically evaluate the robustness of fine-tuned Transformer models against domain shifts and utilize SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) to illuminate their decision boundaries. blocks.en: While recent studies have begun to explore SHAP for the explainability of AI text detectors [ 4 ] , this study uniquely extends this approach by combining global SHAP signatures with systematically selected false negative and false positive case studies in a hyper-local OOD setting. The main contributions of this paper are threefold: • We curate a hyper-local OOD dataset comprising synthetic news articles generated by Llama 3, Mistral, and Gemma alongside authentic human journalism, incorporating randomized temperature parameters to simulate generative variance. • We evaluate the performance drop of baseline models and highlight the utility of diverse training corpora (artem9k) in maintaining low False Positive Rates (FPRs). • We deploy a tripartite xAI framework to analyze the models’ vulnerabilities, identifying the ”Call-to-Action” syndrome of instruction-tuned LLMs, the ”Specificity Bias” that enables AI to bypass detection, and the ”Wikipedia Paradox”, illustrating how formal human writing triggers AI detection mechanisms. To support reproducibility and facilitate future research, the complete source code, the custom hyper-local OOD dataset, and the high-resolution SHAP visualizations are publicly available on GitHub at: https://github.com/morloher779/xai-analysis .

blocks.en: II Related Work
blocks.zh: 二. 相关工作

blocks.en: II-A AI Text Detection and Domain Shifts
blocks.zh: II-A AI 文本检测和域移位

blocks.en: The detection of machine-generated text has evolved from traditional statistical approaches to advanced neural methodologies. Baseline models heavily rely on fine-tuning pre-trained Transformers [ 5 ] , leveraging the contextual embeddings of models like Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers (BERT) or its robustly optimized variant, RoBERTa [ 6 ] , as well as its distilled version, DistilBERT [ 7 ] , to perform binary sequence classification. However, recent studies highlight the generalization challenges of these systems [ 8 ] . Detectors trained on specific domains, such as academic essays or structured question-answering datasets like HC3 PLUS [ 9 ] , often experience performance degradation when exposed to OOD data, showing variations in recall or increased False Positive Rates.
blocks.zh: 对机器生成的文本的检测已经从传统的统计方法演变为先进的神经方法. 基线模型严重依赖微调预训变换器[5],利用了从变换器(BERT)或其强烈优化的变体"RoBERTa [6]"等模型的上下文嵌入,以及其蒸馏版本"DistilBERT [7]"来进行二进制序列分类. 然而,最近的研究突出了这些系统在普遍化方面的挑战[8]。 接受过特定领域培训的探测器,例如学术论文或HC3 PLUS[9]等结构化的问答数据集,在接触OD数据时,往往会发生性能退化,显示回想率的变化或增加的假正率.

blocks.en: Recent parallel work by Mady et al. [ 10 ] has explored feature-augmented Transformers to enhance robustness across diverse domains and generators, utilizing handcrafted linguistic signals to stabilize performance under shift. Our work complements this quantitative mitigation by providing a qualitative xAI analysis, exposing exactly why standard architectures fail before such augmentations are applied.
blocks.zh: Mady等人最近的并行工作 [10] 探索了特性增强变形器,以提高不同领域和发电机的稳健性,利用手动语言信号来稳定变相下的业绩。 我们的工作通过提供定性的xAI分析来补充这种量化的缓解,确切地揭示了标准架构在应用这种增强之前失败的原因。

blocks.en: II-B Generative Variance and Dataset Curation
blocks.zh: 二-B 基因差异和数据集校正

blocks.en: To counter the issue of domain overfitting, the curation of highly diverse training corpora has become paramount. Datasets like artem9k [ 11 ] attempt to bridge this gap by aggregating human and AI texts across various platforms, including Reddit and web text. Additionally, the detection landscape is challenged by the generative variance introduced by different sampling parameters. Variations in the temperature setting of LLMs directly manipulate the text’s perplexity and burstiness. Consequently, robust evaluation methodologies must simulate this variance to accurately reflect real-world adversarial settings.
blocks.zh: 为了解决域位过度调整的问题,管理高度多样化的训练公司已经变得至关重要。 artem9k [11]等数据集试图通过将人文和AI文本汇总到包括Reddit和网络文本在内的各种平台来弥补这一差距. 此外,不同取样参数引入的基因差异对探测地貌提出了挑战。 LLMs 的温度设定变化直接操纵了文本的模糊和快感. 因此,强有力的评价方法必须模拟这种差异,以准确反映现实世界的对抗环境。

blocks.en: II-C Explainable AI (xAI) in Natural Language Processing (NLP)
blocks.zh: II-C 自然语言处理(NLP)解释性AI(xAI)

blocks.en: Despite advancements in detection accuracy, the interpretability of Transformer-based classifiers remains a challenge. Explainable AI frameworks, particularly SHAP [ 12 ] , have been adapted for NLP to compute token-level attributions, highlighting which words drive a specific classification. While previous research utilizes SHAP primarily for local keyword verification, our work extends this paradigm. Instead of isolated local explanations, we utilize aggregated global SHAP signatures and targeted illustrative case studies (False Negatives and False Positives) to systematically analyze the semantic artifacts and structural biases.
blocks.zh: 尽管在检测准确性方面取得了进展,但变形器分类器的可解释性仍然是一个挑战。 解释性的AI框架,特别是SHAP [12]被修改为NLP来计算符号级的归属,突出哪个词驱动特定的分类. 虽然以前的研究主要利用SHAP进行本地关键词验证,但我们的工作扩展了这一范式. 我们没有孤立的局部解释,而是利用汇总的全球SHAP签名和有针对性的说明性案例研究(假阴性与假阳性)来系统分析语义学文物和结构偏差.

blocks.en: III Methodology
blocks.zh: 页:1 方法

blocks.en: In this section, we detail the end-to-end pipeline of our research: from the curation of raw datasets and the synthetic generation of out-of-distribution texts, over the architectural fine-tuning, to the core of our study—the Explainable AI (xAI) framework utilized to decode the models’ decision boundaries.
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们详细说明了我们研究的端到端管道:从原始数据集的整理和综合生成的出发文本,到建筑的微调,到我们研究的核心 -- -- 解释性AI(xAI)框架,用于解码模型的决定界限。

blocks.en: III-A Dataset Curation and Synthetic Generation
blocks.zh: III-A 数据集校正和合成生成

blocks.en: To establish a baseline for AI text detection, we fine-tuned our pre-trained Transformer models on two distinct datasets (architectural details are given in Section III.C). The first one is the HC3 PLUS dataset from Su et al. [ 9 ] , which extends the original HC3’s human–ChatGPT QA pairs ( GPT-3.5-Turbo ) with semantic-invariant transformations such as paraphrasing, summarization, and translation. This extension better reflects post-edited or re-expressed AI text in real-world practice. The second one is the artem9k/ai-text-detection-pile dataset [ 11 ] , which is more varied and consists of human and AI-generated text from GPT-2, GPT-3, ChatGPT, and GPT-J. The human text includes a variety of Reddit, web text, and human responses from HC3. This makes the dataset significantly broader and versatile compared to HC3 PLUS.
blocks.zh: 为了确定AI文本检测的基线,我们在两个不同的数据集上微调了我们经过预先训练的变形器模型(architectural specials in III.C). 第一个是来自Su等人的HC3 PLUS数据集. [9],它扩展了HC3最初的人类-ChatGPT QA对(GPT-3.5-Turbo)的语义-不变量的变换,如抛写,概括,和翻译等. 这个扩展更好地反映了在现实世界实践中编辑后或重新表达的AI文本. 第二种是蒿9k/ai-text-detection-pile数据集[11],该数据集较为多变,由GPT-2,GPT-3,ChatGPT,和GPT-J生成的人类和AI出品文本组成. 人文文本包括各种Reddit,网络文本,以及HC3的人类回应. 因此,与HC3 PLUS相比,数据集范围要大得多,具有多种用途。

blocks.en: To evaluate models’ generalization capabilities and their vulnerability to domain shifts, we created a custom OOD dataset. We utilized the News_Category_Dataset_v3.json from Kaggle [ 13 ] , which contains around 210,000 headlines from HuffPost between the years 2012 and 2022 spanning various categories, from politics and comedy to home & living. Using these headlines, we synthesized corresponding articles. To achieve this, we deployed the Ollama framework [ 14 ] on our local hardware infrastructure and instructed three different state-of-the-art open-source models—Llama 3 [ 15 ] , Mistral [ 16 ] , and Gemma [ 17 ] —to generate articles. The prompt for each generation was as follows: ’You are a local community reporter writing for a hyper-local neighborhood app. Your tone is informative, grounded, and straightforward. Avoid overly flowery language, complex metaphors, or typical AI filler words (like ’moreover’, ’delve’, ’tapestry’).’ .
blocks.zh: 为了评估模型的通俗化能力以及它们易受域位变化影响的程度,我们建立了一个定制的OOD数据集。 我们使用来自Kaggle [13] 的News_Category_Dataset_v3.json, 包含2012至2022年间HuffPoost的约21万条头条新闻, 利用这些头条,我们综合了相应的文章. 为此,我们在当地硬件基础设施上部署了奥拉马框架[14],并指示了三种最先进的开源模型——Llama 3 [15],Mistral [16],和Gemma [17]——生成文章. 每代的提示如下: 你是一个本地社区记者, 你的语气是丰富的、有根据的和直截了当的。 避免过于花开的语言,复杂的比喻,或典型的AI填充词(比如"多出","去","去","去"等). 。 。 。 。

blocks.en: To prevent the detection models from overfitting to a specific statistical signature, the temperature parameter T T during the generation process was uniformly randomized, such that T ∼ 𝒰 ⁡ ( 0.4 , 0.9 ) T\sim\mathcal{U}(0.4,0.9) . This specific range was deliberately chosen to capture a broad spectrum of generation behaviors, ranging from highly deterministic and factual text ( T = 0.4 T=0.4 ) to more creative, variable, and unpredictable output ( T = 0.9 T=0.9 ). In total, we generated a pool of 7,635 AI texts (2,545 per model) and scraped the corresponding human articles.
blocks.zh: 为防止检测模型过于适合特定统计签名,生成过程中的温度参数T T被统一随机化,因此T ∼ U ⁡ (0.4,0.9) T\sim\mathcal{U} (0.4.0.9). 这一特定范围是被故意选择来捕捉广泛的生成行为,从高度定型和事实文字(T=0.4 T=0.4)到更具创造性,可变性和不可预测的输出(T=0.9 T=0.9). 我们总共产生了7,635个AI文本(每个模型2,545个),并刮去相应的人文文章.

blocks.en: From this overarching pool, we constructed the final hold-out OOD test dataset consisting of 4,796 articles. The discrepancy between the initial generation pool (7,635 AI texts) and the final test set arises from the constraints of acquiring the human ground truth. Since the News Category Dataset [ 13 ] provides external URLs to original articles, several sources were unreachable due to dead links or paywalls at the time of scraping. To maintain the rigorous 1:3 class imbalance (1,199 human texts and 3,597 AI texts), AI-generated articles were only included if their corresponding human counterpart was successfully retrieved. This ensures a direct, paired comparison between authentic human reporting and LLM-synthesized content based on identical headlines, while preventing the models from learning spurious correlations based on differing headline distributions.
blocks.zh: 我们从这个总体集合中构建了由4,796篇文章组成的最后搁置OD测试数据集. 初始生成池(7,635 AI文本)与最终测试集之间的差异源于获取人地真理的制约. 由于"新闻类"数据集[13]为原始文章提供外部URL,有多个来源由于在刮去时的死链接或付费墙而无法访问. 为了维持严格的1:3类不平衡(1,199个人类文本和3,597个AI文本),AI所生成的文章只有在其对应的人类文本被成功取回后才会被收录. 这确保了根据相同的头条对真实的人类报告与LLM合成内容进行直接的对接比较,同时防止模型根据不同的头条分布来学习虚假的关联.

blocks.en: III-B Data Preprocessing and Tokenization
blocks.zh: 三-B 数据处理和托肯化

blocks.en: To ensure high quality data and prevent artifacts from influencing the model predictions, we systematically preprocessed all raw text corpora. This pipeline included the removal of residual HTML tags, special characters, and structural noise, followed by deduplication to prevent data leakage between the training and testing sets.
blocks.zh: 为了保证高质量的数据,防止文物影响模型预测,我们系统地预先处理所有原始文本corpora. 该管道包括去除残存的HTML标记,特殊字符和结构噪声,并继而分解来防止培训和测试套件之间的数据泄漏.

blocks.en: The cleaned text sequences were dynamically padded and truncated to a maximum length of 512 tokens to comply with the input constraints of the Transformers. To achieve this we processed the cleaned data with the help of the pre-trained tokenizers by Hugging Face. This was done for DistilBERT and RoBERTa, respectively.
blocks.zh: 被清理的文字序列被动态地加成并被分解到最长为512个令牌以遵守变形器的输入限制. 为了实现这个目标,我们在Hugging Face的预训活化器的帮助下,处理了被清理的数据. 这分别是为了DistilBERT和RoBERTa。

blocks.en: The synthesized out-of-distribution dataset and the scraped human articles were systematically truncated to reflect real-world constraints typical of social media feeds or short-form journalism. We applied sentence-aware truncation at the first terminal punctuation mark (e.g., period, exclamation mark, or question mark) after  150 words to avoid artifacts (e.g., missing final punctuation) that detectors could exploit as trivial cues.
blocks.zh: 综合的传播外数据集和被刮去的人类文章被系统地截取,以反映社交媒体素材或短形式的新闻报道中典型的现实世界制约因素. 在150个字之后,我们在第一个终端点标(如:期、感叹号或问号)应用了句子感知分叉,以避免探测器可能作为小提示而加以利用的文物(如:缺失的最后点标)。

blocks.en: This ensures that all input sequences remain syntactically complete. Preventing abruptly severed sentences is methodologically crucial; otherwise, the Transformer models might exploit these structural artifacts (e.g., missing end punctuation) as a trivial shortcut for classification, rather than learning the underlying semantic and linguistic differences between human and AI text. By maintaining natural sentence boundaries, this approach more accurately captures post-edited or re-expressed AI-generated text as observed in real-world usage. Furthermore, enforcing this strict maximum length makes it harder for the detectors to distinguish between human and AI text based purely on length, inherently restricting the evaluable statistical variance (such as burstiness and perplexity) and serving as a deliberate stress test for the models.
blocks.zh: 这确保所有输入序列在战术上保持完整. 防止突然分出句子在方法上至关重要;否则"变形"模型可能利用这些结构文物(如缺失的端点)作为分类的细微捷径,而不是学习人类文字和AI文字之间的基本的语义和语言差异. 通过保持自然句子边界,这种方法能更准确地捕捉出真实世界用法所观察到的后版或再版的AI生成文本. 此外,执行这一严格的最长长度使探测器更难纯粹根据长度区分人文文字和AI文字,本质上限制了可评价的统计差异(如爆破和迷惑等),并充当模型的刻意压力测试.

blocks.en: III-C Model Architectures and Fine-Tuning Strategy
blocks.zh: 三-C 示范建筑和精益求精战略

blocks.en: To establish a computationally efficient baseline for sequence classification, DistilBERT was employed. DistilBERT is based on BERT, whereby it uses knowledge distillation to retain 97 % of BERT’s language understanding capabilities while reducing the parameter count by 40 %. This makes it highly suitable for rapid baseline evaluations on the HC3 dataset. Alongside DistilBERT we implemented an advanced architecture for domain-shift analysis. To investigate whether architectural depth mitigates vulnerability to out-of-distribution texts, RoBERTa (roberta-base) was selected as the secondary model. Unlike DistilBERT, RoBERTa utilizes dynamic masking and was pre-trained on a substantially larger corpus, theoretically equipping it with more robust contextual representations necessary for detecting hyper-local, LLM-generated nuances.
blocks.zh: 为了建立计算效率的序列分类基准,采用了DistilBERT。 DistilBERT基于BERT,它使用知识分馏来保留BERT97%的语言理解能力,同时将参数数减少40%. 这使得它非常适合对HC3数据集进行快速基线评价. 除了DistillBERT之外,我们还实施了一个高级架构,用于域-转移分析。 为了调查建筑深度是否减轻了对分发外文本的脆弱性,罗贝塔(roberta-base)被选为二级模型. 与DistilBERT不同的是,RoBERTA使用动态口罩,并预先在大得多的体上训练,理论上为它配备了检测超局部和LLM产生的细微差别所必需的更强的上下文表现.

blocks.en: Both models were fine-tuned using the Hugging Face Trainer API for binary sequence classification (Human vs. AI). To adapt the pre-trained language models for the specific downstream task of AI text detection, a sequence classification head was appended to the architecture. Specifically, a linear dropout layer followed by a dense projection layer was placed on top of the final hidden state of the special classification token. Note that the exact token notation reflects the models’ respective tokenizer vocabularies: [CLS] for DistilBERT and <s> for RoBERTa. This configuration maps the high-dimensional contextual text embeddings directly into a binary label space (Label 0: Human, Label 1: AI).
blocks.zh: 两个型号均被精细地使用Hugging Face Trainer API进行二进制序列分类(Human vs. AI). 为了使预训语言模型适应AI文本检测的特定下游任务,架构上还附加了序列分类头. 具体地说,在特殊分类符的最后隐藏状态上方放置了线性抛出层和密集投影层. 请注意,确切的符号符号反映了模型各自的符号词汇:DistilBERT的[CLS]和RoBERTa的 " s". 此配置将高维背景文本直接嵌入二进制标签空间(Label 0: Human,Label 1: AI).

blocks.en: The end-to-end fine-tuning process was orchestrated utilizing the Hugging Face Transformers library [ 18 ] and its highly optimized Trainer API, ensuring a standardized, hardware-accelerated, and reproducible training loop. The networks were trained by minimizing the standard Cross-Entropy Loss.
blocks.zh: 端到端的微调过程是利用Hugging Face Transformers库[18]及其高度优化的训练员API来安排的,确保一个标准化的,硬件加速的,可再生的训练循环. 这些网络的培训是通过尽量减少标准的交叉输入损失。

blocks.en: The gradient descent optimization was driven by the AdamW algorithm [ 19 ] . In standard Adam, an L2 penalty added to the loss is divided by the adaptive second-moment term, meaning weights with a large gradient history are regularized less [ 19 ] . AdamW addresses this by applying the decay directly to the weights, decoupled from the adaptive step [ 19 ] . This algorithmic adaptation is the standard choice for fine-tuning Transformers [ 19 ] .
blocks.zh: 梯度下降优化由亚当W算法驱动 [19]. 在标准亚当中,在损失中再加一分L2的罚分被适应性的二分法分出,指梯度历史较大的重量被正规化较少 [19]. AdamW通过将衰变直接应用到重量上,与适应步骤[19]脱钩来解决了这个问题. 这种算法适应是微调变形器的标准选择[19].

blocks.en: To ensure full reproducibility, we detail the fine-tuning hyperparameters: Both models were trained for 3 epochs using a batch size of 16 to accommodate the maximum sequence length of 512 tokens. We employed an initial learning rate of 2 × 10 − 5 2\times 10^{-5} with a linear learning rate scheduler and no warmup steps. Early stopping was configured across all training runs by monitoring the validation loss with a patience of 2 epochs, ensuring that the checkpoint with the best validation loss was automatically restored at the end of the training phase.
blocks.zh: 为确保完全可再生产,我们详细说明微调超参数: 两种型号都为3个纪元进行训练,使用16个分批大小来适应512个令牌的最大序列长度. 我们的初始学习率是2×10×5 2.\Times 10×5}有一个线性学习速度计,没有热身步骤。 通过监测验证损失,在两个纪元的耐心下,对运行的所有培训都进行了早期停车配置,以确保在培训阶段结束时自动恢复最优验证损失的检查站。

blocks.en: The selection of hyperparameters followed established empirical best practices for fine-tuning Transformer architectures on specialized downstream tasks [ 5 ] . A batch size of 16 was chosen to maintain a balance between memory efficiency and gradient stability on the RTX Pro 5000 Blackwell GPU. The learning rate of 2 × 10 − 5 2\times 10^{-5} was selected as it represents the recommended ”sweet spot” for BERT-based models, facilitating convergence while preventing the catastrophic forgetting of pre-trained linguistic weights [ 5 ] . Furthermore, training was limited to 3 epochs; preliminary tests indicated that additional iterations primarily led to overfitting on the stylistic nuances of the training corpora (e.g., HC3’s specific QA-style) rather than enhancing the general detection of artificial signatures.
blocks.zh: 超参数的选择遵循了完善下游专门任务变形器架构的既定经验最佳做法[5]. 为了在RTX Pro 5000 Blackwell GPU上保持内存效率和梯度稳定性之间的平衡,选择了16个批量尺寸. 选择了2×10−5 2\times 10×5}的学习率,因为它代表了为基于BERT的模型推荐的"甜点",促进了趋同,同时防止灾难性地忘记了预先训练的语言分量[5]. 此外,培训仅限于3个时代;初步测试表明,额外的迭代主要导致对培训蝎子的花样细微差别(例如,HC3的特定QA型)的过度适应,而不是加强对人工签名的一般检测。

blocks.en: During inference, alongside the default classification threshold of 0.5, we report the True Positive Rate (TPR) at fixed low False Positive Rates (1 % and 5 %), reflecting standard operating points in high-stakes environments. Furthermore, to cleanly separate class inseparability from threshold misalignment in a deployment-realistic protocol, we evaluate thresholds calibrated exclusively on the in-distribution validation split and subsequently frozen, thereby avoiding the use of test labels as an oracle.
blocks.zh: 在推论期间,除了0.5的默认分类阈值外,我们报告在固定的低假正率(1%和5%)下的真实正率(TPR),反映了高吸积环境中的标准操作点。 此外,为了在部署-现实性协议中将分类不可分离性与阈值错配性明确区分开来,我们评价完全在分配中验证分拆并随后被冻结的阈值,从而避免使用测试标签作为甲骨文.

blocks.en: III-D Explainable AI (xAI) Framework
blocks.zh: 三-D 解释性AI(xAI)框架

blocks.en: While standard performance metrics such as accuracy, recall, and F1-score provide a macroscopic view of model efficacy, they fail to illuminate the underlying decision-making processes of deep Transformer networks. To address this ”black-box” phenomenon and shift the research focus toward true interpretability, we integrated the SHAP PartitionExplainer , which is specifically optimized for NLP classification pipelines, into our evaluation framework. Based on cooperative game theory, SHAP computes the marginal contribution of each feature—in our context, individual text tokens or sub-tokens—to the final classification output.
blocks.zh: 准确性、回顾和F1-分数等标准性能衡量标准提供了模型效能的宏观视角,但却未能揭示深层变压器网络的基本决策进程。 为了解决这个“黑盒”现象,并将研究重点转向真正的可解释性,我们把SHAP Partition Explainer(专门为NLP分类管道优化的SHAP Partition Explainer)纳入了我们的评价框架。 基于合作游戏理论,SHAP计算每个特性的边际贡献——在我们的背景中,单个的文本符号或子目录——对最终分类输出.

blocks.en: Rather than applying xAI solely for isolated local explanations, our methodology leverages SHAP systematically across three distinct analytical paradigms to dissect the models’ behavior during severe domain shifts: • Global AI Signature Extraction (True Positives): To identify the universal linguistic patterns learned by the detectors, we aggregate local SHAP values across a representative sample of 50 correctly classified AI texts. To avoid favoring rare tokens, we aggregate subwords to words and report frequency-weighted values based on the number of texts in which a token appears. Furthermore, leveraging the paired structure of our OOD dataset, we compute a contrastive signature (AI texts minus their paired human texts) to cleanly separate LLM stylistic artifacts from underlying topic words. • Vulnerability Analysis (False Negatives): To understand the limitations of statistical detection models, SHAP is applied to synthesized texts that successfully bypassed the detector (hereafter referred to as ”Sneaky AI”). This step isolates specific human-mimicking strategies employed by LLMs, allowing us to investigate phenomena such as the specificity bias introduced by hallucinated named entities and rare lexical choices. • The Cross-Domain Paradox (False Positives): To empirically demonstrate the limits of statistical detection, we extend the SHAP analysis to misclassified human texts from a highly formal and structured domain (Wikipedia). This methodological step is designed to visualize how human writing with naturally low statistical variance (low burstiness) triggers the exact same detection mechanisms as AI-generated text. Through this tripartite xAI framework, the methodology transitions from merely benchmarking detection models to uncovering the fundamental lexical vulnerabilities and biases inherent in current AI text detection paradigms.
blocks.zh: 我们的方法不是仅仅为孤立的局部解释而应用xAI,而是系统地利用SHAP跨越三个不同的分析范式,在严重域转移时解析模型的行为: · Global AI Signation Intractionon(True Authoritys): 为了识别探测器所学出的普遍语言模式,我们通过50个正确分类的AI文本的代表性样本,汇总了当地SHAP值. 为了避免偏好稀有的符号,我们将子词归集到单词中,并根据一个符号出现的文本数量报告频率加权值. 此外,我们利用我们的OOD数据集的配对结构,计算出一个对比性签名(AI文本减去其配对的人类文本),将LLM结构化的文物与基本主题词明确区分开来。 • 脆弱性分析(不良因素): 为了理解统计检测模型的局限性,SHAP被应用来合成成功绕过检测器的文本(以下简称"Sneaky AI"). 这一步骤隔离了LLMs采用的具体的人类模仿策略,使我们能够调查幻觉被命名的实体引入的特异性偏差等现象和罕见的词汇选择. 二. 支助 跨域参数( False Authors) : 为了在经验上证明统计检测的极限,我们扩展了SHAP分析的范围,将人类文本从一个高度正规和结构化的领域(Wikipedia)误分类. 这个方法步骤旨在直观地描述具有自然低统计差异(低快感)的人类写作如何触发与AI生成的文本完全相同的检测机制. 通过这个三方的xAI框架,方法从仅仅设定基准的检测模式向发现当前AI文本检测范式所固有的基本词汇弱点和偏见过渡.

blocks.en: Global AI Signature Extraction (True Positives): To identify the universal linguistic patterns learned by the detectors, we aggregate local SHAP values across a representative sample of 50 correctly classified AI texts. To avoid favoring rare tokens, we aggregate subwords to words and report frequency-weighted values based on the number of texts in which a token appears. Furthermore, leveraging the paired structure of our OOD dataset, we compute a contrastive signature (AI texts minus their paired human texts) to cleanly separate LLM stylistic artifacts from underlying topic words.
blocks.zh: 全球AI 签名提取(真实积极性): 为了识别探测器所学出的普遍语言模式,我们通过50个正确分类的AI文本的代表性样本,汇总了当地SHAP值. 为了避免偏好稀有的符号,我们将子词归集到单词中,并根据一个符号出现的文本数量报告频率加权值. 此外,我们利用我们的OOD数据集的配对结构,计算出一个对比性签名(AI文本减去其配对的人类文本),将LLM结构化的文物与基本主题词明确区分开来。

blocks.en: Vulnerability Analysis (False Negatives): To understand the limitations of statistical detection models, SHAP is applied to synthesized texts that successfully bypassed the detector (hereafter referred to as ”Sneaky AI”). This step isolates specific human-mimicking strategies employed by LLMs, allowing us to investigate phenomena such as the specificity bias introduced by hallucinated named entities and rare lexical choices.
blocks.zh: 脆弱性分析(伪负数): 为了理解统计检测模型的局限性,SHAP被应用来合成成功绕过检测器的文本(以下简称"Sneaky AI"). 这一步骤孤立了LLMs所采用的具体的人类模仿策略,使我们能够调查幻觉被命名的实体引入的特异性偏差等现象和罕见的法理选择.

blocks.en: The Cross-Domain Paradox (False Positives): To empirically demonstrate the limits of statistical detection, we extend the SHAP analysis to misclassified human texts from a highly formal and structured domain (Wikipedia). This methodological step is designed to visualize how human writing with naturally low statistical variance (low burstiness) triggers the exact same detection mechanisms as AI-generated text.
blocks.zh: 跨域参数( False Authors) : 为了从经验上证明统计检测的局限性,我们扩展了SHAP分析范围,将人类文本从一个高度正规和结构化的领域(Wikipedia)误分类. 这个方法步骤旨在直观地描述具有自然低统计差异(低快感)的人类写作如何触发与AI生成的文本完全相同的检测机制.

blocks.en: IV Results
blocks.zh: 四. 结果

blocks.en: In this section, we present the quantitative performance metrics of the fine-tuned Transformer models. The evaluation focuses on the models’ robustness against domain shifts, measuring Accuracy, Macro F1-score, Recall for the AI class (True Positive Rate), and the False Positive Rate (FPR)—the latter being a critical metric for real-world applications where falsely accusing human authors is highly penalized.
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们介绍了微调变压器模型的量化性能衡量标准。 评估的重点是模型相对于域位变化的稳健性,衡量准确性,Macro F1-score, 回顾AI类(真正率)和假正率(FPR)——后者是真实世界应用的关键衡量标准,其中诬告人类作者受到严厉惩罚。

blocks.en: TABLE I : Performance Evaluation of Fine-Tuned Transformer Models Across Different Domains
blocks.zh: 表格 I: 不同领域精细变形器模型的性能评价

blocks.en: IV-A Performance on Out-of-Distribution Local News
blocks.zh: 四-A 发行外地方新闻的表现

blocks.en: The initial evaluation was conducted on the custom hyper-local news dataset, representing an extreme OOD scenario characterized by short text lengths (approx. 150 words) and high generative variance. As detailed in Table I , the computationally lightweight DistilBERT baseline, fine-tuned on the QA-heavy HC3 PLUS dataset, exhibited a highly conservative prediction threshold. It achieved a near-perfect FPR of 0.08 % (misclassifying only 1 out of 1,199 human texts) but struggled to detect the LLM-generated texts, resulting in a recall of only 46.0 % at the default threshold, despite near-perfect precision. This highlights a severe conservative classification bias rather than statistical inferiority. This gap is primarily attributed to the ”QA-bias” inherent in the HC3 PLUS training data. Having been fine-tuned on structured question-answering pairs, the model effectively learned to identify the linguistic markers of a helpful AI assistant (e.g., introductory politeness, structured lists) rather than universal synthetic patterns. When confronted with the objective, reporting-oriented tone of hyper-local news, the model fails to recognize the generative artifacts, as they lack the instruction-following indicators present in its training distribution.
blocks.zh: 初步评价是针对自定义的超局部新闻数据集进行的,它代表了一种极端的OOD情景,其特点是文字长度短(约150个字)和高基因差异. 如表一所详述的,在QA-HC3 PLUS数据集上微调的计算轻量级DistilBERT基线显示出高度保守的预测阈值。 它实现了0.08%的接近完美FPR(在1,199个人类文本中只有1个错误分类),但努力去检测LLM生成的文本,结果在默认阈值上只召回了46.0%,尽管接近完美精度. 这凸显出严重的保守分类偏差,而不是统计自卑. 这一差距主要归因于HC3 PLUS培训数据固有的“QA-bias”。 在对结构化的问答对等进行微调后,模型有效地学会了识别一个有帮助的AI助手的语言标记(如入门礼让,结构化列表)而不是通用的合成模式. 在面对客观、面向报道的超地方新闻时,该模式未能识别出遗传文物,因为它们缺乏培训分发中的指导性指标。

blocks.en: Upgrading the architectural depth to RoBERTa while maintaining the HC3 PLUS training data resulted in overfitting to the target domain. Although the model correctly identified nearly 100 % of the AI-generated texts, the FPR surged to 43.37 %. This indicates a severe lack of generalization, rendering the model practically unusable in environments where human text is prevalent.
blocks.zh: 在维持HC3 PLUS训练数据的同时将建筑深度提升到RoBERTa,导致过于适合目标域. 虽然该模型正确识别出近100%的AI生成文本,但FPR却猛增到43.37%. 这表明严重缺乏通俗化,使模型在人类文字盛行的环境中实际上无法使用。

blocks.en: However, training the RoBERTa architecture on the highly diverse artem9k dataset successfully mitigated this domain-shift vulnerability. The model restored the optimal FPR of 0.08 % while slightly improving the baseline’s AI recall to 48.0 % and maintaining an overall accuracy of 61.0 %.
blocks.zh: 然而,对RoBERTA架构进行关于高度多样化的Artem9k数据集的培训,成功地减轻了这种域相变的脆弱性。 该模型恢复了0.08%的最佳FPR,同时略微将基准的AI召回率为48.0%并保持了61.0%的整体精度.

blocks.en: IV-B Cross-Domain Performance on Formal Text
blocks.zh: 四-B 正式文本的跨领域性能

blocks.en: To further assess the generalization capabilities and the impact of text length and formal structure on the detection mechanisms, the best-performing model (RoBERTa trained on artem9k) was subjected to a cross-domain evaluation using the GPT-wiki-intro dataset [ 20 ] . It is important to acknowledge a methodological asymmetry in this setup: while the primary OOD testing set consists of texts generated by open-source LLMs (Llama 3, Mistral, Gemma), the synthetic portions of this Wikipedia dataset were generated by OpenAI’s GPT-3 Curie ( text-curie-001 , temperature 0.7). These texts were synthesized using a 200-word prompt combined with a shared seven-word prefix from the authentic human introductions.
blocks.zh: 为了进一步评估通俗化能力以及文本长度和正式结构对检测机制的影响,使用GPT-wiki-intro数据集对最佳性能模型(德语:RoBERTa trained on artem9k)进行了跨域评价[20]. 必须承认这个设置中的方法不对称:虽然初级OD测试集由开源LLMS(Llama 3, Mistral, Gemma)生成的文本组成,但这个维基百科数据集的合成部分是由OpenAI的GPT-3 Curie(text-curie-001,温度为0.7)生成的. 这些文本是用200个字的快取来合成的,结合了人类正宗介绍中共享的7个字前缀.

blocks.en: By simultaneously shifting two variables—the topical domain and the generative architecture—it becomes difficult to isolate whether subsequent performance deviations are driven by the structural formality of Wikipedia or the specific artifacts of GPT-3 Curie. While we explicitly address this confounding factor as a limitation in Section VI, this setup serves as a broad, worst-case evaluation of the detector’s overarching robustness in the wild.
blocks.zh: 通过同时转移两个变量——主题域和基因结构——变得难以孤立后续的性能偏差是由维基百科的结构形式驱动还是由GPT-3 Curie的特定文物所驱动. 虽然我们在第六节中明确提到这个令人困惑的因素,

blocks.en: The results demonstrate a significant leap in overarching performance metrics compared to the short local news snippets. The model achieved an accuracy of 85.0 % and an AI recall of 87.0 %, successfully identifying the vast majority of ChatGPT-generated encyclopedia entries. Concurrently, however, the FPR increased significantly to 16.95 %, with 339 out of 2,000 genuine human Wikipedia authors being falsely flagged as AI. This stark contrast in FPR between the hyper-local news domain and the academic Wikipedia domain highlights a critical behavioral shift in the detector when confronted with highly structured, formal human writing.
blocks.zh: 结果显示,与短片的当地新闻相比,总体业绩衡量标准有了重大突破。 该模型实现了85.0%的精度和87.0%的AI召回,成功识别了绝大多数ChatGPT所生成的百科全书条目. 然而,与此同时,FPR大幅上升至16.95%,在2,000名真正的人类维基百科作者中,有339人被诬为AI. FPR中超局部新闻域和学术维基百科域之间的这种鲜明对比凸显出在面对高度结构化,形式化的人文写作时,探测器的批评行为转变.

blocks.en: IV-C Confusion Matrices and Threshold Dynamics
blocks.zh: IV-C 混血症和阈值动态

blocks.en: While overarching metrics such as Macro F1-score and Accuracy provide a general performance overview, the real-world applicability of AI text detectors is best evaluated through the exact distribution of classification errors. Table II provides the detailed Confusion Matrices for all tested configurations, illuminating the specific trade-offs between false accusations (False Positives) and missed synthetic texts (False Negatives).
blocks.zh: 虽然Macro F1-score和精确度等总的度量衡提供了总体性能概览,但AI文本检测器的真实世界适用性最好通过分类错误的准确分布来评价. 表二提供了所有被测试配置的详细迷惑矩阵,揭示了虚假指控(假阳性)和错失合成文本(假阴性)之间的具体取舍.

blocks.en: TABLE II : Confusion Matrices for Evaluated Model Configurations
blocks.zh: 表二:用于评价模型配置的困惑矩阵

blocks.en: The matrices clearly visualize the stark behavioral differences driven by the training corpora. The DistilBERT baseline and RoBERTa trained on artem9k share a nearly identical, highly conservative profile on the hyper-local OOD dataset. Both models prioritize the protection of human authors at all costs, resulting in a single False Positive out of 1,199 human texts. However, this safety comes at the severe expense of detection capability, letting approximately 52 % of the AI-generated texts slip through undetected. This reflects a significant conservative classification bias. Both models prioritize high precision (100 %) to minimize the risk of false accusations—a critical requirement for maintaining trust in journalistic or academic contexts. Consequently, in the subtle and neutral domain of local news, the detectors default to a ”Human” prediction unless overt, stereotypical AI artifacts are identified. This indicates that the default 0.5 decision boundary is improperly calibrated for short-form OOD detection, as the models’ internal confidence scores for AI text are systematically lower in this novel domain.
blocks.zh: 矩阵清晰地描绘出训练科罗拉所驱动的鲜明行为差异. DistilBERT基线和接受Artem9k训练的RoBERTA在超局部OOD数据集上分享了几乎相同,高度保守的概况. 这两种模式都以不惜一切代价保护人类作者为优先,结果在1,199个人类文本中产生了一个单一的"虚假正文". 然而,这种安全性是以严重地牺牲检测能力为代价的,使得AI生成的文本中约52%通过未被检测出. 这反映了明显的保守分类偏差. 这两种模式都优先考虑高度精确性(100%),以尽量减少被诬告的风险——这是保持对记者或学术界的信任的关键要求。 因此,在地方新闻的微妙和中立领域,探测器默认为“人类”预测,除非发现公开的、陈规定型的人工智能文物。 这表明默认的0.5决定边界对短式OOD检测的校正不当,因为模型内部对AI文本的信心分数在这个新领域系统较低.

blocks.en: Conversely, the RoBERTa model trained solely on HC3 PLUS flips this behavior entirely. It acts as an aggressive filter, capturing 3,587 out of 3,597 AI texts (missing only 10), but causing 520 false accusations against genuine human writers. This highlights a fundamental thresholding dilemma: at the default 0.5 decision boundary, current models either act as overly permissive filters or overly aggressive accusers, emphasizing the need for application-specific calibration (e.g., tuning the threshold via validation sets or utilizing AUROC to optimize the operating point) rather than relying on static binary outputs.
blocks.zh: 反之,仅受HC3 PLUS训练的RoBERTa模型完全翻转了这种行为. 它充当了侵略性的过滤器,在3,597个AI文本中捕获了3,587个(只丢失了10个),但导致520个对真正的人类作家的虚假指控. 这凸显出一个根本性的入门困境:在默认的0.5决定边界上,目前的模型要么是过度放任的过滤器,要么是过于激进的指责者,强调需要针对应用程序进行校正(例如,通过验证组来调整阈值,或者利用AUROC来优化操作点),而不要依赖静态二进制输出.

blocks.en: IV-D Threshold-Independent Evaluation: AUROC and AUPRC
blocks.zh: 四-D 最低限值独立评价:非洲办事处和非盟项目审查委员会

blocks.en: Given the severe class imbalance in the OOD dataset (1:3 ratio of human to AI texts) and the extreme variations observed in the confusion matrices at the default 0.5 classification threshold, a threshold-independent evaluation is required. To assess the models’ inherent ability to separate human from synthetic text across all possible decision boundaries, we computed the Area Under the Receiver Operating Characteristic curve (AUROC) and the Area Under the Precision-Recall Curve (AUPRC). AUPRC is particularly highly informative in this context, as it is more sensitive to false positives in imbalanced datasets than AUROC.
blocks.zh: 鉴于OOD数据集(人与AI文本的比例为1:3)存在严重的阶级不平衡,且在默认的0.5分级阈值的混淆矩阵中观察到了极端的差异,因此需要进行阈值独立的评价. 为了评估这些模型跨越所有可能的决定边界将人文文字与合成文字分开的固有能力,我们计算了接收器操作特征曲线下的区域(AUROC)和精度-召回曲线下的区域(AUPRC)。 在这方面,非盟炼油公司的信息特别多,因为它比非洲大气研究组织更能敏感地了解不平衡数据集中的假阳性。

blocks.en: TABLE III : Threshold-Independent Performance Metrics
blocks.zh: 表 三:阈值-独立性能计量

blocks.en: Fig. 1 : Receiver Operating Characteristic (ROC) curves for the evaluated models on the hyper-local OOD dataset. The curves demonstrate that while RoBERTa (artem9k) achieves excellent class separation, its default 0.5 threshold is severely miscalibrated for this domain.
blocks.zh: 图1:超局部OOD数据集被评价模型的接收器操作特征(ROC)曲线. 曲线显示,虽然RoBERTa(artem9k)实现了优秀的类分,但其默认的0.5阈值对于这个域来说却严重地被校正了.

blocks.en: As Table III and Figure 1 illustrate, the threshold-independent metrics reveal a significantly different performance narrative compared to the static F1-scores previously presented in Table I . Most notably, RoBERTa trained on artem9k achieves an outstanding AUROC of 0.995 and an AUPRC of 0.965 on the hyper-local OOD dataset.
blocks.zh: 如表三和图一所说明的,与表一中以前列报的静态F1-分数相比,独立阈值指标显示的绩效说明有显著不同。 最显著的是,经过青蒿素9k培训的RoBERTa在超局部OD数据集上取得了0.995的杰出AUROC和0.965的AUPRC。

blocks.en: This exposes a critical insight regarding model deployment: The underlying contextual embeddings of RoBERTa (artem9k) successfully learn to separate human text from AI text with high confidence. The catastrophic drop in recall (48.0 %) observed in Table I is not a failure of the model’s representational power, but rather a severe miscalibration of the default 0.5 decision boundary when transferred to a novel, short-form domain. The model’s logits are systematically shifted, requiring a recalibrated threshold to achieve an optimal balance between precision and recall. While tuning the threshold via Youden’s J statistic directly on the test domain acts as an oracle ceiling, a threshold fixed strictly on in-distribution validation data offers a deployment-realistic mitigation. Conversely, RoBERTa trained on HC3 PLUS shows a much lower AUROC (0.806), confirming that its high FPR is caused by a fundamental inability to separate the classes in the OOD space, rather than just a thresholding misalignment.
blocks.zh: 这揭示了对模型部署的重要见解: RoBERTa(artem9k)的基本背景嵌入成功学习了将人文文本与AI文本高度自信地相分离. 在表一中观察到的灾难性的召回下降(48.0 % ) 并不是模型代表力的失败,而是在转移至新颖的短形域时对默认的0.5决定边界的严重误判. 该模型的对数有系统转移,需要重新调整阈值,以便在精确度和召回度之间实现最佳平衡。 虽然通过Youden的J统计直接在测试领域调整阈值可以起到神谕上限的作用,但严格固定在分配中验证数据的阈值可以提供部署现实性的缓解。 反之,接受过HC3 PLUS培训的RoBERTa显示AUROC(0.806)要低得多,证实其高水平的FPR是从根本上无法在OOD空间中分出班次,而不只是分级错误.

blocks.en: V Discussion
blocks.zh: 五. 讨论情况

blocks.en: The quantitative results and confusion matrices highlight a fundamental trade-off in current AI text detection paradigms. From a practical deployment perspective, the configurations exhibit vastly different real-world consequences. While the DistilBERT baseline minimizes false accusations, missing over half of the AI-generated content (46.0 % Recall) makes it highly problematic for use cases like automated content moderation, where filtering synthetic spam is the primary goal. Conversely, the 43.37 % FPR observed in RoBERTa-HC3 indicates massive overfitting to the target domain. In practical terms, this renders the model entirely unsuitable for high-stakes environments—such as academic grading or journalistic vetting—where falsely accusing a human author of using AI carries severe reputational penalties.
blocks.zh: 量化结果和混淆矩阵凸显出当前AI文本检测范式中的根本取舍. 从实际部署的角度来看,这些配置显示出截然不同的现实世界后果。 虽然DistilBERT基线将虚假指控最小化,但超过一半的AI生成的内容缺失(46.0%回想),使得使用自动化内容节制等案例(过滤合成垃圾邮件是首要目标)的问题非常严重. 反之,在RoBERTa-HC3中观察到的43.37%的FPR显示与目标域的高度相配. 在实践中,这使得这种模式完全不适合高考环境,如学术评级或新闻审查,在这种环境中,诬告一位人类作者使用AI会受到严厉的名誉处罚。

blocks.en: To decode the underlying reasons for these performance variations and to understand how modern LLMs (Llama 3, Mistral, Gemma) mimic or fail to mimic human writing, we analyze the models through our tripartite xAI framework.
blocks.zh: 为了解码这些性能变化的根本原因并了解现代LLMS(Llama 3,Mistral,Gemma)如何模仿或未能模仿人类作文,我们通过我们的三方xAI框架来分析模型.

blocks.en: In this section we’re working with two different colors—red and blue—to visualize the decision making of our chosen transformers. Red symbolizes a push towards AI-creation for any token and blue means the transformer evaluates it as human-made.
blocks.zh: 在这个节目中,我们用两种不同的颜色——红色和蓝色——来想象我们所选择的变压器的决策。 红色象征着向AI-创造的推力,对任何活物来说,蓝色意味着变压器评价它是人造的.

blocks.en: V-A Vulnerabilities in AI Detection: A SHAP Analysis
blocks.zh: V-A AI检测中的弱点:SHAP分析

blocks.en: V-A 1 The Global AI Signature and ’Assistance Behavior’
blocks.zh: V-A 1 全球AI签名和援助行为

blocks.en: To extract the overarching lexical features that the RoBERTa model associates with artificial generation, we computed the global SHAP values across correctly classified AI texts (True Positives).
blocks.zh: 为了提取RoBERTA模型与人工生成相关联的统称法特征,我们通过正确分类的AI文本计算出全球SHAP值。

blocks.en: Fig. 2 : Global SHAP Signature: Top tokens driving the ’AI’ classification in hyper-local news.
blocks.zh: 图2:全球特别行动计划 签署: 在超本地新闻中,

blocks.en: The global SHAP analysis reveals that the detector did not rely on stereotypical AI filler words (which were explicitly suppressed via the generation prompt). Instead, it identified deeper generative narratives. The highest positive impact values for the AI class were assigned to tokens such as ’If’ , ’interested’ , and ’questions’ . This exposes a profound behavioral artifact of instruction-tuned LLMs: the ”Call-to-Action” syndrome. Unlike human journalists who report objectively, models like Llama 3, Mistral or Gemma inherently default to an assistance-oriented tone, frequently concluding articles with service-oriented phrases (e.g., ”If you are interested, please reach out”). Furthermore, the prominence of tokens like ’charity’ and ’Sally’ indicates that the models attempt to simulate hyper-local contexts by hallucinating wholesome community stereotypes, a pattern the detector successfully learned to flag.
blocks.zh: 全球SHAP分析显示,探测器并不依赖于陈规定型的AI填充词(这些词通过生成快取被明确压制). 相反,它确定了更深层次的基因叙述。 AI类最高的正面影响值被分配到"如果","感兴趣"和"问题"等符号上. 这揭示了“呼吁行动”症候群的深刻行为特征。 与客观报道的人类记者不同,Llama 3,Mistral或Gemma等模型在本质上默认为以援助为主的语气,经常用以服务为主的短语来结尾文章(例如"如果你感兴趣,请伸出援手"). 此外,像 " 魅力 " 和 " 萨利 " 这样的标志的显著性表明,这些模型试图通过幻觉健康的社区定型观念来模拟超局部环境,而这种模式是探测器成功学会的。

blocks.en: V-A 2 The True Positive: Generic Framing and the ”Feel-Good” Bias
blocks.zh: 五A类 2 真正的积极:一般的花纹和“感觉好”比亚斯

blocks.en: Figure 3 illustrates an extreme True Positive case—a synthetic article about a poverty bill where the models are over 99.8 % confident of its artificial origin. The visualization reveals a striking difference in both architectural depth and training data influence (DistilBERT fine-tuned on HC3 PLUS versus RoBERTa fine-tuned on artem9k). While training DistilBERT on artem9k would complete a 2x2 experimental design to isolate architectural depth perfectly, the current setup confirms that shallow models trained on QA-datasets overfit to the generic, helpful tone typical of instruction-tuned LLMs.
blocks.zh: 图3显示了一个极端真实的正面案例——关于贫穷法案的合成文章,其中模型对人为来源的信心超过99.8%。 该可视化揭示了建筑深度和培训数据影响的显著差异(DistilBERT在HC3 PLUS上微调与RoBERTa在artem9k上微调). 虽然关于Artem9k的DistilBERT培训将完成一个2x2实验设计,以完美地隔离建筑深度,但目前的设置证实,在QA-数据集上训练的浅层模型过于符合典型的通俗而有帮助的调子-调子LLMs.

blocks.en: In contrast, RoBERTa exhibits a much more granular understanding. It flags generalized, non-specific journalistic framing in red (e.g., ”A recent study suggests”, ”could make a significant”), but notably highlights the specific statistical claim ”reducing poverty by 3.3 million people” in blue. RoBERTa recognizes that concrete numbers are typically human journalistic traits, but the overwhelming presence of synthetic filler words still rightfully triggers the overall AI classification.
blocks.zh: 相形之下,RoBERTA表现出了更具有颗粒性的理解. 它用红色标出一般的、非特定的新闻框架(例如,“最近的一项研究表明,”“可以产生一个重大的影响”),但突出地突出了具体的统计说法“将贫穷减少330万人”。 RoBERTA承认具体数字通常是人类的新闻特征,但合成填充词的压倒性存在仍然正确地触发了整体AI分类.

blocks.en: Fig. 3 : Architectural Comparison on a True Positive (RoBERTa (artem9k) Confidence: 99.80 %). Both models exhibit > 99 % >99\,\% certainty of artificial origin. Red tokens push toward AI; blue tokens push toward Human.
blocks.zh: 图3:真实正面的建筑比较(ROBERTA(artem9k)) 信心:99.80%)。 两种模型都显示出 > 99 % > 99\,%的人工来源确定性。 红色的指使向AI;蓝色的指使向人类.

blocks.en: V-A 3 The False Negative: Specificity Bias and Human Imperfection
blocks.zh: 五A类 3 假阴性:特异性和人体缺陷

blocks.en: To understand the critical limitations of these detectors, Figure 4 shows a ”Sneaky AI” False Negative—a synthetic text that tricked both models into near 100 % certainty that it was written by a human. The text reports on a fictionalized ”Cowboys For Trump” trial.
blocks.zh: 为了理解这些探测器的关键局限性,图4显示一种“偷窥AI”假阴性——一种合成文本,它使两种模型几乎100%地确定它是由人类所写的。 文中报道了虚构的"牛仔为特朗普"审判.

blocks.en: Fig. 4 : Architectural Comparison on a False Negative (”Sneaky AI”, 0.02 % AI Confidence, DistilBERT (HC3 PLUS)). The presence of specific Named Entities overwhelmingly pushes the prediction toward Human (blue).
blocks.zh: 图4 : 假负数的建筑比较(“Sneaky AI”),0.02% AI Confession, DistilBERT (HC3 PLUS). 具体命名实体的存在压倒性地将预测推向了人类(蓝色).

blocks.en: The SHAP heatmap clearly exposes the Specificity Bias . Both DistilBERT and RoBERTa are overwhelmingly pushed toward the ’Human’ class (blue) by highly specific, hallucinated Named Entities, such as ”Mesa County Courthouse”, ”Thomas Biggs”, and ”Judge Rosemary Barkett”. Furthermore, the dramatic journalistic opening (”A tense silence hung in the air”) is heavily weighted as human.
blocks.zh: SHAP加热图明显暴露了特异性比亚斯。 DistilBERT和RoBERTA都绝大多数被非常具体、具有幻觉的命名实体推向人类阶层,例如 " 梅萨县法院 " 、 " 托马斯·比格斯 " 和 " 罗斯玛丽·巴克特法官 " 。 此外,戏剧性的记者开场( " 空气中的紧张的沉默 " )被严重视为人。

blocks.en: This observation is further corroborated by the local ranked token attribution for this specific text, shown in Figure 5 . Instead of relying on generic abstractions, the model generated specific Named Entities, such as the fictional tourist ”Harding”, which had the absolute highest impact score (+0.0242) pushing the prediction toward the human class. In the training corpora, such factual specificity regarding previously unmentioned individuals correlates strongly with human journalism. Furthermore, the high impact of the sub-token ”ifted” (derived from ”airlifted”) shows the LLM utilized rare vocabulary rather than predictable verbs like ”transported”. The phrase ”slightly conscious” introduces a degree of conversational imperfection, mimicking a human eyewitness account.
blocks.zh: 图5显示的这一具体文本的当地排序符号归属进一步证实了这一看法。 该模型没有依赖一般抽象,而是产生了特定的命名实体,例如虚构的游客“Harding”,其影响得分绝对最高(+0.0242),将预测推向了人类阶层。 在培训中,关于先前未提及的个人的这种具体事实与人类新闻密切相关。 此外,从“空运”中衍生出来的子语句的影响很大,表明LLM使用了稀有词汇,而不是“运输”等可预测的动词。 “略觉”一词引入了某种程度的谈话不完善,模仿了人类目击者的说法。

blocks.en: Fig. 5 : Local SHAP Analysis of a False Negative (’Sneaky AI’): Tokens pushing the prediction toward the ’Human’ class.
blocks.zh: 图5:当地SHAP对假负方的分析( ' Sneaky AI ' ): 将预测推向人类阶层。

blocks.en: This dual visualization illustrates that statistical detectors do not possess a semantic understanding of truth; they merely associate a dense web of specific proper nouns and stylistic narrative flair with human journalism. When an LLM successfully hallucinates these features, it bypasses the detection mechanisms entirely.
blocks.zh: 这种双重可视化表明,统计探测器对真理不具有语义性的理解;它们只是将一个密集的网格,由特定的名词和斯式叙事性能与人类新闻联系起来。 当LLM成功幻出这些特征时,它会完全绕过检测机制.

blocks.en: V-A 4 The Wikipedia Paradox: Limits of Statistical Detection
blocks.zh: 五A类 4 维基百科 参数:统计检测的限度

blocks.en: The cross-domain evaluation on the Wikipedia dataset yielded a significantly higher FPR of 16.95 %, exposing a critical limitation of current detection paradigms. To investigate why genuine human authors were frequently flagged as artificial, we extracted the SHAP values of a misclassified, human-written encyclopedia entry (Figure 6 ).
blocks.zh: 维基百科数据集的跨域评价得出显著高的FPR为16.95%,暴露出当前检测范式的关键局限性. 为了调查为什么真正的人类作者经常被标注为人为的,我们提取了SHAP的一个错误的,由人类书写的百科全书条目(图6.

blocks.en: Fig. 6 : The Wikipedia Paradox: Local SHAP values of a genuine human text misclassified as AI.
blocks.zh: 图6:维基百科中的相关条目: 相克活佛 真实人文文字的本地SHAP值被误归类为AI.

blocks.en: The tokens driving the ’AI’ prediction include factual entities, structural descriptors, and standard grammatical markers: ’John’ (+0.0149), ’original’ (+0.0149), and ’an’ (+0.0149).This supports the hypothesis that the detector associates structural formality, factual density, and emotional detachment with artificial generation. While burstiness and perplexity were hypothesized but not empirically measured in this study, future work should directly compute these metrics (e.g., via GPT-2) across the 339 misclassified texts versus the correctly classified ones to test the ”Wikipedia Paradox” quantitatively. Furthermore, aggregating SHAP attributions over all 339 false positives would solidify the impact of these objective function words beyond isolated case studies.
blocks.zh: 推动 " AI " 预测的标志包括事实实体、结构描述符和标准语法标记: " John " (+0.0149)、 " 原始 " (+0.0149)和 "an " (+0.0149)。 这支持了探测器将结构形式,事实密度,情感分解与人工生成相联的假设. 虽然本研究中假设了爆炸性和复杂性,但没有按经验加以衡量,但今后的工作应当直接计算出339个错误分类文本与正确分类文本之间的这些衡量标准(例如通过GBT-2),以便从数量上检验“Wikipedia Paradox”。 此外,汇总所有339个假阳性因素的SHAP属性,将巩固这些客观功能词的影响,超越孤立的案例研究。

blocks.en: VI Limitations
blocks.zh: 六. 限制

blocks.en: While this study provides valuable interpretability insights into the decision-making processes of AI text detectors, several methodological limitations must be acknowledged. First, the out-of-distribution evaluation is constrained to a single hyper-local news domain and Wikipedia introductions, operating exclusively in the English language.
blocks.zh: 虽然这项研究为AI文本探测器的决策过程提供了宝贵的解释性见解,但必须承认一些方法上的局限性。 一,外放评价受限于单一的超本地新闻领域和维基百科介绍,专用英语运营.

blocks.en: Second, modern LLMs function as highly adaptive adversaries. Our ”Sneaky AI” analysis serves as an initial, illustrative step toward understanding adversarial generation patterns. However, it is not an exhaustive robustness evaluation against deliberate evasion techniques, such as targeted prompt injection, structural obfuscation, or multi-agent rewriting pipelines.
blocks.zh: 第二,现代有限责任公司作为高度适应性的对手发挥作用。 我们的“狡猾的AI”分析是了解对抗性生成模式的初步、说明性步骤。 然而,它并不是针对故意逃避技术,如定向即时注射、结构模糊或多剂重写管道的详尽有力评价。

blocks.en: Third, there is an intentional dataset asymmetry that impacts broad generalization claims: the primary OOD test set focuses exclusively on open-source generation models (Llama 3, Mistral, Gemma), whereas the cross-domain Wikipedia dataset (GPT-wiki-intro) evaluates texts generated by OpenAI’s GPT-3 Curie. Additional confounding variables include the reliance on a single training seed, as well as a potential prompt confound between the hyper-local instructions given to the LLMs and the national scope of the scraped human news articles.
blocks.zh: 第三,有一种有意的数据集不对称,影响广义的通论主张:初级OD测试集完全侧重于开源生成模型(Llama 3, Mistral, Gemma),而跨域的维基百科数据集(GPT-wiki-intro)则评价由OpenAI的GPT-3 Curie生成的文本. 其他混乱的可变因素包括依赖单一的训练种子,以及可能迅速混淆给LLMS的超局部指示和被刮去的人类新闻文章的国家范围。

blocks.en: VII Conclusion
blocks.zh: 七. 结论

blocks.en:
This study investigated the robustness and interpretability of Transformer-based AI text detectors under domain shifts. By evaluating against a custom OOD dataset generated by open-source LLMs (Llama 3, Mistral, Gemma), we observed that models fine-tuned on diverse corpora (artem9k) generalize better and maintain lower False Positive Rates compared to those trained on narrow datasets (HC3 PLUS). Through the application of a tripartite SHAP framework, we demonstrated that detectors rely on specific generative artifacts, such as the ”Call-to-Action” syndrome, rather than generic AI markers. We also illustrated the ”Specificity Bias,” where LLMs bypass detection via targeted named entity hallucination, and the ”Wikipedia Paradox,” showing that formal, low-burstiness human writing often triggers false positive classifications.

These findings suggest that purely statistical detection paradigms face inherent limitations when applied to formal human domains. Future work should expand this evaluation to multi-lingual contexts to assess cross-linguistic generative patterns. Furthermore, the development of next-generation detectors should explore contrastive training approaches to better separate formal human intellect from synthetic generation, and investigate watermarking-based hybrid detection systems to establish more reliable, semantic-aware authentication mechanisms.
blocks.zh:
这项研究调查了基于变形器的AI文本探测器在域位移下的强性和可解释性. 通过对照开源LLMS(Llama 3, Mistral, Gemma)生成的自定义OOD数据集进行评估,我们观察到,对多种公司(artem9k)的模型进行了微调,比那些在狭义数据集(HC3 PLUS)上接受过培训的模型更好地概括并保持了较低的假正率. 通过应用一个三方SHAP框架,我们证明探测器依赖于特定的基因学文物,例如“呼吁行动”综合征,而不是通用AI标记. 我们还举例说明了“特定比阿斯”, LLMS通过目标实体的幻觉绕过检测,以及“Wikipedia Paradox,” 表明正式的、低模糊的人类写作往往触发虚假的正分级。

这些调查结果表明,纯统计检测模式在适用于正式的人类领域时面临固有的局限性。 今后的工作应当将这一评价扩大到多种语言背景,以评估跨语言的基因模式。 此外,下一代探测器的开发应探索对比性培训方法,以更好地将人类的正式智力同合成人分开,并调查以水标记为基础的混合探测系统,以建立更可靠、语义意识更强的认证机制。

blocks.en: Example 1 (corresponding to Figure 7 ): The Raven’s Claw is an all-male senior honorary society at Dickinson College. It was founded in 1896, making it the first society unique to Dickinson College and one of the oldest in the country. Membership is limited to seven senior men who are selected by the seven previous members. The new members are chosen based on a variety of factors, which are speculated to include: campus leadership, a solid academic record, and athletic participation. While those are often the factors associated with membership in the Raven’s Claw Society, no one knows for certain how or why members are selected. Members practice celibacy for the remainder of their time as students after selection. New members are inducted in a ”Tapping Ceremony” which is held on the ”Old Stone Steps of Old West.” The ceremony is traditionally conducted during commencement weekend. They are called ”claws” or ”white hats”, denoting the white caps they wear around campus to signify unity and loyalty on certain days throughout the year.
blocks.zh: 例1(与图7相对应):"乌鸦爪"是迪金森学院的全男性高级荣誉社会. 它成立于1896年,成为迪金森学院所独有的第一个社会,也是该国最古老的学会之一. 成员限于7名资深男子,由7名前成员选出。 新成员是根据各种因素挑选的,这些因素被推测包括:校园领导、扎实的学术记录和体育参与。 虽然这些往往是与拉文爪会成员有关的因素,但没有人知道成员是如何或为什么被挑选的。 会员在选取后作为学生在剩余时间内练习独身. 新成员在“旧西边的旧石阶上”举行“监听仪式”。 仪式传统上在开始的周末举行. 他们被称为 " 法律 " 或 " 白色帽子 " ,指他们在校园周围所戴的白色帽子,以表示全年某些天的团结和忠诚。

blocks.en: Example 2 (corresponding to Figure 7 ): The Helena Confederate Cemetery is located in the southwest corner of the Maple Hill Cemetery on Holly Street in Helena, Arkansas. It is a small section of the larger cemetery, under one acre in size, and is marked by two significant memorials: the Confederate Memorial and the memorial to Confederate Army General Patrick Cleburne, whose burial here is the only known place associated with his life. The Cleburne memorial is a marble shaft in height, topped by an urn with flames coming from its top. The Confederate Memorial is a marble depiction of a soldier, mounted on a granite shaft, surrounded by pyramids of cannonballs and inverted cannons. The cemetery has more than 100 marked graves, 15 of which are unidentified Confederate dead, and 23 are of those killed in the 1863 Battle of Helena. The cemetery was listed on the National Register of Historic Places in 1996.
blocks.zh: 例2(对应图7):海伦娜邦联公墓位于阿肯色州海伦娜街枫山公墓西南角. 它是更大的公墓的一个小地段,面积在一亩以下,并有两座重要的纪念地:邦联纪念碑和邦联陆军上将帕特里克·克勒伯恩的纪念地,其葬地是这里唯一已知与他生活相联的地方. Clebune纪念馆是一座高地上的大理石柱子 顶部有火焰 邦联纪念馆是一座大理石上描绘一名士兵,被安装在花岗岩井上,周围被金字塔式的大炮和倒置的大炮所包围. 该墓地有超过100个有标记的坟墓,其中15个是不明身份的邦联人所死,23个是1863年海伦娜战役中阵亡. 该墓地于1996年被列入"国家历史地名登记表".

blocks.en: Example 3 (corresponding to Figure 7 ): A full-time job is employment in which a person works a minimum number of hours defined as such by their employer. Overview Full-time employment often comes with benefits that are not typically offered to part-time, temporary, or flexible workers, such as annual leave, sick leave, and health insurance. Part-time jobs are mistakenly thought by some to not be careers. However, legislation exists to stop employers from discriminating against part-time workers so this should not be a factor when making decisions on career advancement. They generally pay more than part-time jobs per hour, and this is similarly discriminatory if the pay decision is based on part-time status as a primary factor. The Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA) does not define full-time employment or part-time employment. This is a matter generally to be determined by the employer (US Department of Labor). The definition by the employer can vary and is generally published in a company’s Employee Handbook. Companies commonly require from 32 to 40 hours per week to be defined as full-time and therefore eligible for benefits.
blocks.zh: 例3(对应图7): 全职工作是指由雇主规定的最低工时。 全职就业往往带来通常不向非全时、临时或灵活工人提供的福利,如年假、病假和健康保险。 非全时工作被一些人误认为不是职业。 但是,有立法阻止雇主歧视非全日制工人,因此,在作出职业晋升决定时,这不应是一个因素。 她们通常每小时工资超过非全时工作,如果报酬决定是以非全时地位为首要因素,这同样也是歧视性的。 《公平劳动标准法》(FLSA)没有界定全职或兼职就业。 这个问题一般由雇主决定(美国劳工部)。 雇主的定义可能有所不同,一般会在公司的《雇员手册》中公布。 公司通常要求每周32至40小时为全职,因此有资格享受福利。

blocks.en: Example 4 (corresponding to Figure 7 ): Yu Lihua (28 November 1929 – 30 April 2020) was a Chinese writer who authored over thirty works - novels, short stories, newspaper articles and translations in a span of sixty years. She is regarded as ”one of the five most influential Chinese-born women writers in the postwar era and the progenitor of the Chinese students’ overseas genre.” She wrote primarily in Chinese, drawing on her experience as a Chinese émigré in postwar America. She was celebrated in the diaspora for giving voice to what she called the ”rootless generation” — émigrés who had left for a better life but remained nostalgic for their homeland. She was more than a successful writer, but a bridge, a cultural ambassador between China and the US. In 1975, she was one of the first individuals to be invited back to China after relations between the two countries were re-opened. Her work, which until then had been blacklisted in China, began to focus on life in China. Through sponsorship of scholarly exchange programs, her column in China’s People’s Daily newspaper, and radio broadcasts on the Voice of America, she educated both the American and Chinese public about life in each other’s countries.
blocks.zh: 例4(与图7相对应):于丽华(1929年11月28日-2020年4月30日)是一位中国作家,创作了30多部作品-小说,短篇小说,报纸文章和翻译长达60年. 她被认为是"战后时代最有影响力的五位出产于中国的女作家之一,也是中国学生海外流派的后代". 她主要用汉语写作,借鉴了战后美国华人移民的经历. 她因为她所谓的“无根的一代”——为过上更美好的生活而离开但依然怀念祖国的移民——献出自己的声音而获得海外侨民的赞誉。 她不仅是一位成功的作家,而是一座桥梁,是中美两国之间的文化大使. 1975年,她被两国关系重新开放后,成为首批被邀请回中国的个人之一. 她的作品一直以来在中国被列入黑名单,开始关注中国的生活. 她通过赞助学术交流节目、在中国《人民日报》的专栏以及美国之音的电台广播,向美国和中国公众宣传对方国家的生活。

Example 5 (corresponding to Figure 7 ): The following events occurred in November 1946: November 1, 1946 (Friday)
In what the National Basketball Association (NBA) credits as its first game, the New York Knicks defeated the Toronto Huskies 68–66. The only game scheduled for the opener of what was then called the Basketball Association of America took place in Canada. Ossie Schectman of the Knicks scored the first points in the first game. The night before, the first exhibition game of the season for the National Basketball League (which would merge with the BAA to form the NBA) saw the pro debut of George Mikan, who scored 19 points for the Chicago Gears in a 55-50 loss to the Rochester Royals.
At Kraków, Archbishop Adam Sapieha personally ordained 26-year-old Karol Wojtyla as a Roman Catholic priest. Father Wojtyla’s career would see him rise through the hierarchy of the Church, becoming Pope John Paul II in 1978.
In what has been described as ”the beginning of modern accelerator technology”, a beam of alpha particles was accelerated at the synchrotron in Berkeley, California, to generate an unprecedented 350 MeV of energy.

纽约尼克斯队击败了多伦多胡斯基斯68-66队。 原定为当时被称作"美国篮球协会"的开局者所参加的唯一一场比赛在加拿大进行. 尼克斯队的奥西·舍克特曼(英语:Ossie Schectman (film))在首场比赛中打出第一分. 前一天晚上,全国篮球联赛(将同BAA合并以组成NBA)赛季的首个出场比赛看到了乔治·米坎(英语:George Mikan (film))的首发出场,他在对罗切斯特皇家队的55-50分的失利中为芝加哥球队打出19分.

在被描述为"现代加速器技术的开始"中,一束α粒子被加速于加利福尼亚州伯克利的同步星上,产生出前所未有的350MEV能量.

blocks.en: Example 1 (corresponding to Figure 8 ): Title: Celebrating Local Talent at the Oscars 2022: A Look at Our Neighborhood’s Wins. In a star-studded night, the Oscars 2022 honored the best in cinema worldwide. Among the celebrated films, our local community had its share of triumphs to cheer about. Resident filmmaker, Alex Johnson, won an Oscar for Best Documentary Short Subject with his work “The Distant Barking of Dogs”. His heartfelt portrayal of life in Ukraine struck a chord with the Academy, and we couldn’t be prouder. Local actor, Sarah Davis, also made history by winning the award for Best Supporting Actress for her role in “Minari”. Her moving performance as the strong-willed Monica Yi resonated deeply with viewers, and now our own neighborhood can boast an Oscar winner! Our community’s creative spirit continues to shine brightly on the global stage. Congratulations to Alex Johnson, Sarah Davis, and all the talented individuals who make our neighborhood a vibrant hub of artistic excellence.
blocks.zh: 例1(与图8相对应):标题:在2022年奥斯卡颁奖典礼上庆祝地方才华:一看我们的邻居胜利. 2022年奥斯卡颁奖典礼 荣获全球最佳电影奖 在著名的电影中, 我们的当地社区有它的一部分胜利 欢呼。 驻地电影制片人亚历克丝·约翰逊凭借他的作品"狗的出众"获得了奥斯卡最佳纪录片短片主题奖. 他对乌克兰生活的衷心描写, 当地演员莎拉·戴维斯(Sarah Davis)也因出演"Minari"而获得"最佳支持女演员"奖而创历史. 她作为强烈意志的莫妮卡的感人表演 依依与观众的共鸣很深,现在我们自己的邻居可以夸耀出奥斯卡奖得主了! 我们社会的创造精神继续在全球舞台上闪耀出光芒。 祝贺亚历克丝·约翰逊,莎拉·戴维斯,以及所有那些使我们社区成为一个充满活力的优秀艺术中心而富有才华的个人.

blocks.en: Example 2 (corresponding to Figure 8 ): Title: Local Perspective: A Potential Impact of the Crowded GOP Field on a Hypothetical Trump 2024 Campaign. In our neighborhood, political discussions are as vibrant as ever, with the potential 2024 presidential race taking center stage. The growing field of Republican candidates could have significant implications for a hypothetical Trump campaign, according to local political analysts. The crowded landscape might benefit Trump in several ways. Firstly, the divided opposition could strengthen his position as the most recognizable and controversial figure among Republicans, potentially attracting voters who feel disillusioned with other candidates. Secondly, a divisive primary could lead to a weaker nominee, making it easier for Trump to secure the party’s nomination if he chooses to run again. However, it’s important to note that these are speculative scenarios. The dynamics of the race can change rapidly, and many factors will influence the outcome, including candidates’ policies, campaign strategies, and public sentiment. Residents are encouraged to stay informed and engage in respectful discussions about this evolving political landscape. As always, your participation in local politics helps shape our community’s future.
blocks.zh: 例2(与图8相呼应):标题:地方视角:被拥挤的GOP场对一场假想特朗普2024运动的潜在影响. 政治讨论与以往一样充满活力, 当地政治分析人士认为,共和党候选人人数日增,可能对假想的特朗普竞选活动产生重大影响. 拥挤的地貌可能从几个方面给特朗普带来好处. 首先,分裂的反对派可能加强他作为共和党人中最受认可和有争议人物的地位,有可能吸引那些感到对其他候选人失望的选民. 第二,分裂的初级党员可能导致更弱的被提名人,使特朗普在选择再次参选时更容易获得党的提名. 然而,重要的是要注意到,这些是投机性的假设。 种族的动态可以迅速变化,许多因素将影响结果,包括候选人的政策、竞选策略和公众情绪。 鼓励居民保持知情,并参与关于这种不断变化的政治格局的相互尊重的讨论。 与往常一样,你们参与当地政治有助于塑造我们社区的未来。

blocks.en: Example 3 (corresponding to Figure 8 ): Local Star Willie Garson’s ‘And Just Like That’ Was Headed for Split. Did you catch last night’s ‘And Just Like That’ finale? While the reboot offered closure on many fronts, it seems some storylines remained untied. Local favorite Willie Garson, known for his portrayal of Stanford, was reportedly set to appear in a storyline involving a divorce. Though the episode aired without this plot point, whispers suggest that the writers had already penned scenes exploring the breakdown of Stanford’s marriage. With Garson’s sudden passing in July, those scenes unfortunately never made it to air. The ‘And Just Like That’ team has remained tight-lipped about potential future plans, but many fans hope to see Garson’s character receive some form of tribute in future episodes or spin-offs.
blocks.zh: 例3(与图8相对应):本地明星威利·加森(Willie Garson)的"就像那样"(And Just Like that)被划为分块. 你昨晚的"和那一样"最后的结局了吗? 虽然重启在许多方面提供了关闭,但一些故事线似乎仍然没有解开。 当地最喜爱的威利·加森(Willie Garson)以对斯坦福的描写而出名,据说被设定出现在涉及离婚的故事情节中. 虽然剧集播出时没有这个情节点, 7月加森突然逝去, 但许多粉丝希望看到Garson的性格在未来节目或附带节目中受到某种形式的赞扬。

blocks.en: Example 4 (corresponding to Figure 8 ): Local Journalist Takes Aim at Governor DeSantis. Miami Herald’s editorial board recently dropped a bombshell on local politics with their stinging critique of Governor Ron DeSantis. The editorial, titled “The Pinocchio Problem,” argues that DeSantis’ constant shifting of blame and his reliance on misinformation have eroded public trust in his leadership. This isn’t the first time the Herald has taken a stand against DeSantis’ policies. Earlier this year, they criticized his controversial education bill that critics dubbed the “Don’t Say Gay” bill. The editorial argues that these actions undermine democracy and threaten freedom of speech. Local reactions are varied. Some residents applaud the Herald’s boldness, while others criticize the paper for being too political. Others still remain undecided, citing the need for more information before forming an opinion.
blocks.zh: 例4(对应图8):地方记者以德桑蒂斯总督为对象. 迈阿密先驱报的编辑部最近对当地政治投下炸弹, 社论题为"皮诺曹问题"(The Pinocchio problem), 这并非《先驱报》第一次对德桑蒂斯的政策采取立场。 今年早些时候, 他们批评他有争议的教育法案, 社论认为,这些行动会破坏民主并威胁言论自由. 各地的反应各不相同. 有些居民称赞"先驱报"的大胆,而另一些居民则批评该报过于政治性. 其他人仍未作出决定,理由是在形成意见之前需要更多信息。

blocks.en: Example 5 (corresponding to Figure 8 ): Betty White Fans Get a Touch of Home in Birthday Message. Local legend Betty White’s 100th birthday bash didn’t just feature stars and streamers. The beloved actress’s beloved Angels baseball team shared a heartfelt video message she filmed just days before her passing. Filmed at her favorite spot, the Rusty Anchor restaurant on Ocean Avenue, Betty beams with her trademark wit as she expresses gratitude for her fans’ unwavering support. She reminisces about her childhood days in nearby Encino, mentioning how much she loved watching Angels games with her family. The video ends with a montage of Betty’s career highlights and a chorus of “Happy Birthday” sung by her fellow Angels players. The team plans to air the message during their next home game at Dodger Stadium next week.
blocks.zh: 例5(与图8相对应): Betty White Fans Get a Touch of Home in Birthday Message. (英文). 当地传说Betty White百岁生日狂欢不只是明星和流星。 爱心的女演员Angels棒球队分享了她在逝去前几天拍摄的一段真诚的视频信息。 拍摄地点是海洋大道的Rusty Anchor餐厅, 她回忆起自己在附近恩西诺的童年时光,提到她有多喜欢与家人一起观看"天使"游戏. 影片以贝蒂的生涯亮点为结尾, 球队计划下周在道奇体育场的下一场主场比赛中播出这个消息.

blocks.en: Example 1 (corresponding to Figure 9 ): Title: Tragic Incident at Los Angeles Music Festival: Community Mourns Drakeo The Ruler. The hospital has implemented additional security measures and is working with police to ensure the safety of their patients.
